task_title: Reconcile slicer to brief grid on single-axis over-segmentation

plan_review.notes: Separate-model (gpt-5.4) design review of the FINAL variance-min-cut reconciliation, after pivoting from the earlier alignment-gated design (which a prior review flagged for masking). Verdict: design sound, NO blocking issues. 3 important + 2 minor concerns, all addressed: (1) width-evenness can mispick under extreme block-width asymmetry (a central phantom can beat a real gutter) -> ACCEPTED per explicit product-owner decision 2026-07-07 that human gallery review is the semantic gate; covered by a documented-limitation test (widths 12,20,8 mispick still emits the commanded count) plus a robustness test (widths 10,14,12 keeps both real gutters). (2) blast-radius via public SliceOptions.expectedGrid -> sliceSheetFromBrief is the generation-only wrapper; added a debugger-path test proving no-expectedGrid keeps the raw content-aware grid. (3) deterministic tie-break -> documented in selectEvenCuts (integer cost + strict < keeps the leftmost subset) and added a determinism test. Minor: per-axis independence endorsed (no change); degenerate zero-area cells unreachable on real sheets (both reviewers concur) -> added positive-area assertions. Implemented the reviewer must-have test list.

code_review.note: Round 1 (claude-sonnet-4.6, at c77f0153): no concerns. Round 2 (gpt-5.4): 2 blocking bugs the first pass missed - uniformCuts could emit a zero-width cell (crash) when an under-segmented axis was reconciled on a near-empty content span, and the rerun grid-change guard compared only variant COUNT so a same-count reshape (2x2->1x4) slipped through; both fixed in 5698b13c (strict-monotonic cuts + full grid-STRUCTURE guard via persisted summary.grid). Round 3 (gpt-5.4): 2 more - those fixes were incomplete: uniformCuts still forced cuts past the axis when the commanded grid was larger than the sheet itself (axisMax < targetCells) crashing extractCell, and sameEmptyCells used set membership so it was blind to multiplicity; both fixed in cb76dd5f (per-cell bounds clamp in computeSliceMap makes the slicer total; brief-schema rejects duplicate emptyCells; sameEmptyCells now canonical/multiset compare). Round 4 (gpt-5.4): confirmed both round-3 issues resolved and found no new bugs or regressions -> clean. Loop closed. Regression tests added for the degenerate sheet-smaller-than-grid slice and duplicate-emptyCells rejection.
